ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Probability > 0.80, OR( Pricebook2.Name = "CPQ", ISBLANK(Pricebook2Id) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Education", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Travel", RecordType.DeveloperName = "B2B", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Healthcare" ), OR( ISBLANK(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__Status__c, "Client_Approved")), ISBLANK(TEXT(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Contract_has_Auto_Renewal_Terms__c)), ISBLANK(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__RenewalTerm__c), SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__RenewalTerm__c = 0), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a Renewal Term. If there is no auto-renewal, enter the full term of the contract (e.g. 36). If there is an auto-renewal, enter the monthly auto renewal term (e.g. 12). This can be adjusted at any time prior to legal stage if needed.
